svg.text: ENTERPRISE AI INFRASTRUCTURE · POST-TRAINING ALIGNMENT & MEMORY SIZING (#376)
DPO vs. SimPO vs. ORPO vs. KTO vs. Two-Stage SimPO + Online GRPO
Eliminating the Frozen Reference Model + Fused Preference Loss Cuts HBM from 102.5 GB to 54.2 GB (1.89x Faster)
Tier 1 Trap: Naive Online-Ref DPO (102.5 GB OOM)
• Keeps both Policy pi_theta (70B) + Frozen Ref pi_ref (70B) in HBM
• Runs 4 forward passes per preference pair (Chosen/Rejected x 2)
• Suffers from length-bias verbosity & off-policy reasoning ceiling
• 102.5 GB/GPU Peak HBM (Crashes on 80GB H100!) & 81.2% Score
Tier 4: SimPO (Liger Fused) -> Online Verifiable GRPO
preference alignment at 54.2 GB/GPU (1.89x faster, zero verbosity)
• Stage 2 (Online GRPO): Sandbox/rubric RL on hard SQL/Code/Math
• 56.8 GB Peak HBM & 92.8% Composite Alignment/Reasoning Score
4-Tier Post-Training Alignment Matrix (70B Full-Param · 50k Pairs · 16x H100 80GB)
Tier 1 (Naive Online-Ref DPO) : Peak HBM = 102.5 GB (OOM) | Speed = 1.00x | Score = 81.2% | Cost = $4,600
Tier 2 (Precomputed-Ref DPO) : Peak HBM = 72.0 GB (Fit) | Speed = 1.48x | Score = 81.5% | Cost = $3,100
Tier 3 (SimPO/KTO + Liger Fused) : Peak HBM = 54.2 GB (Fit) | Speed = 1.89x | Score = 84.6% | Cost = $1,850
Tier 4 (Two-Stage SimPO -> GRPO) : Peak HBM = 56.8 GB (Fit) | Speed = 1.72x | Score = 92.8% | Cost = $3,450
